# Game Idea: Asteroid Escape

- **Genre:** Top‑down arcade
- **Core Loop:** Use arrow keys to steer a ship through a constantly scrolling field of asteroids.
- **Goal:** Collect fuel cells to stay powered.
- **Lose Condition:** Collision with an asteroid **or** running out of fuel (timer reaches zero).
- **Canvas Features:** Simple sprite drawing, per‑frame movement, collision detection, and a timer UI.

<content>
1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the page.
3: // Controls: Arrow keys to steer the ship.
4: // Collect fuel cells to extend timer; colliding with an asteroid or timer=0 ends the game.
5: 
6: (() => {
7:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
8:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
9:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
10:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
11:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600;
12: 
13:   // Game state
14:   // Starfield background
15:   const stars = Array.from({ length: 100 }, () => ({ x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height, size: Math.random() * 2 + 1 }));
16:   const ship = { x: width / 2, y: height - 60, w: 30, h: 30, speed: 3 };
17:   const keys = { ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false, ArrowUp: false, ArrowDown: false };
18:   let asteroids = [];
19:   let fuels = [];
20:   let timer = 30; // seconds
21:   let lastTime = performance.now();
22:   let spawnAsteroidCooldown = 0;
23:   let spawnFuelCooldown = 0;
24:   let gameOver = false;
25: 
26:   // Audio setup
27:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
28:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
29:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
30:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
31:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
32:     oscillator.type = 'sine';
33:     oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
34:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
35:     oscillator.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
36:     oscillator.start();
37:     oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
38:   }
39: 
40:   // Input handling
41:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { audioCtx.resume(); if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = true; });
42:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = false; });
43: 
44:   function spawnAsteroid() {
45:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
46:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
47:     const angularSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02; // small rotation
48:     asteroids.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, w: size, h: size, speed: 1 + Math.random() * 2, angle, angularSpeed });
49:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
50:     asteroids.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, w: size, h: size, speed: 1 + Math.random() * 2 });
51:   }
52: 
53:   function spawnFuel() {
54:     const size = 15;
55:     fuels.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, r: size / 2, speed: 1.5 });
56:   }
57: 
58:   function rectIntersect(a, b) {
59:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
60:   }
61: 
62:   function circleRectIntersect(circle, rect) {
63:     const distX = Math.abs(circle.x - rect.x - rect.w / 2);
64:     const distY = Math.abs(circle.y - rect.y - rect.h / 2);
65:     if (distX > (rect.w / 2 + circle.r)) return false;
66:     if (distY > (rect.h / 2 + circle.r)) return false;
67:     if (distX <= (rect.w / 2)) return true;
68:     if (distY <= (rect.h / 2)) return true;
69:     const dx = distX - rect.w / 2;
70:     const dy = distY - rect.h / 2;
71:     return (dx * dx + dy * dy <= (circle.r * circle.r));
72:   }
73: 
74:   function update(dt) {
75:     if (gameOver) return;
76: 
77:     // Timer countdown
78:     timer -= dt / 1000;
79:     if (timer <= 0) { timer = 0; playTone(150, 0.5); gameOver = true; }
80: 
81:     // Ship movement
82:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
83:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
84:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed;
85:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
86:     // Keep within bounds
87:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
88:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - ship.h, ship.y));
89: 
90:     // Spawn asteroids
91:     spawnAsteroidCooldown -= dt;
92:     if (spawnAsteroidCooldown <= 0) { spawnAsteroid(); spawnAsteroidCooldown = 800; }
93:     // Spawn fuel cells
94:     spawnFuelCooldown -= dt;
95:     if (spawnFuelCooldown <= 0) { spawnFuel(); spawnFuelCooldown = 5000; }
96: 
97:     // Update asteroids
98:     // Update stars (move down, wrap)
99:     stars.forEach(s => {
100:       s.y += 0.5;
101:       if (s.y > height) {
102:         s.y = 0;
103:         s.x = Math.random() * width;
104:       }
105:     });
106:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
107:       a.y += a.speed;
108:       if (a.angle !== undefined) {
109:         a.angle += a.angularSpeed;
110:       }
111:     });
112:     asteroids = asteroids.filter(a => a.y < height);
113:     // Update fuels
114:     fuels.forEach(f => f.y += f.speed);
115:     fuels = fuels.filter(f => f.y < height);
116: 
117:     // Collision detection
118:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
119:       if (rectIntersect(ship, asteroids[i])) { gameOver = true; break; }
120:     }
121:     for (let i = fuels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
122:       const fuel = fuels[i];
123:       if (circleRectIntersect({ x: fuel.x + fuel.r, y: fuel.y + fuel.r, r: fuel.r }, ship)) {
124:         timer = Math.min(60, timer + 5); // add 5 seconds, cap at 60
125:         fuels.splice(i, 1);
126:         playTone(400, 0.2);
127:       }
128:     }
129:   }
130: 
131:   function draw() {
132:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
133:     // Ship (gradient triangle)
134:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(ship.x, ship.y, ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
135:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
136:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#060');
137:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
138:     ctx.beginPath();
139:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
140:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
141:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
142:     ctx.closePath();
143:     ctx.fill();
144:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#0c0';
145:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
146:     ctx.stroke();
147: 
148:     // Stars (twinkling)
149:     ctx.fillStyle = '#bbb';
150:     stars.forEach(s => {
151:       ctx.beginPath();
152:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
153:       ctx.fill();
154:     });
155: 
156:     // Asteroids (gray with rotation)
157:     ctx.fillStyle = '#777';
158:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
159:       ctx.save();
160:       ctx.translate(a.x + a.w / 2, a.y + a.h / 2);
161:       ctx.rotate(a.angle || 0);
162:       ctx.translate(-a.w / 2, -a.h / 2);
163:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, a.w, a.h);
164:       ctx.restore();
165:     });
166: 
167:     // Fuel cells (yellow circles)
168:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
169:     fuels.forEach(f => {
170:       ctx.beginPath();
171:       ctx.arc(f.x + f.r, f.y + f.r, f.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
172:       ctx.fill();
173:     });
174: 
175:     // Timer UI
176:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
177:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
178:     ctx.fillText('Time: ' + Math.ceil(timer), 10, 30);
179: 
180:     if (gameOver) {
181:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
182:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
183:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
184:       ctx.font = '40px sans-serif';
185:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
186:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
187:     }
188:   }
189: 
190:   function loop(timestamp) {
191:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
192:     lastTime = timestamp;
193:     update(dt);
194:     draw();
195:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
196:   }
197: 
198:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
199: })();

(End of file - total 199 lines)
</content>
